topic.title: Adaptive Online Optimization and Dynamic Regret
topic.overview: Online optimization makes decisions before seeing each new loss, often while the environment or constraints change. This cluster studies regret guarantees for convex objectives, unbounded domains, adversarial constraints, delayed feedback, and movement costs. Adaptive algorithms seek competitive performance without requiring accurate advance knowledge of scales or variation.
topic.whyItMatters: A fixed comparator can hide failure when the best decision changes over time. Dynamic regret and explicit constraint control provide more relevant measures for systems that must keep adapting rather than converge to one permanent answer.
topic.evolution: Early representatives develop online convex programming and no-regret gradients. Later work removes known-bound assumptions and addresses dynamic environments. Recent papers combine anytime constraints, parameter-free movement-aware analysis, and reductions for structured nonconvex objectives, extending online guarantees across feedback and feasibility settings.
openQuestions: Can adaptivity to unknown scales coexist with meaningful constraint guarantees?
How should regret account for delayed information and the cost of changing decisions?

papers.title: Predictive Linear Online Tracking for Unknown Targets
papers.tldr: PLOT learns changing target dynamics online, uses them for predictive control, and provides a regret bound plus a quadrotor demonstration.

papers.title: Projection-Free Online Convex Optimization with Time-Varying Constraints
papers.tldr: The paper develops projection-free online algorithms with sublinear regret and constraint violation, trading stronger interval guarantees for additional oracle requirements.

papers.title: Small-loss Adaptive Regret for Online Convex Optimization
papers.tldr: The paper develops adaptive-regret algorithms with small-loss guarantees across convex function classes and minimax guarantees for non-smooth functions.

papers.title: Two-timescale Derivative Free Optimization for Performative Prediction with Markovian Data
papers.tldr: A two-timescale derivative-free algorithm obtains near-stationarity guarantees when decisions influence Markovian data.

papers.title: A Simple and Adaptive Learning Rate for FTRL in Online Learning with Minimax Regret of $\Theta(T^{2/3})$ and its Application to Best-of-Both-Worlds
papers.tldr: A simple adaptive FTRL learning rate improves best-of-both-worlds regret bounds for several online learning problems with indirect feedback.

papers.title: A Simple and Optimal Approach for Universal Online Learning with Gradient Variations
papers.tldr: A two-layer online ensemble achieves optimal gradient-variation regret across three curvature classes using one gradient query per round.

papers.title: An Equivalence Between Static and Dynamic Regret Minimization
papers.tldr: For linear losses, dynamic regret becomes static regret in a larger space, revealing achievable tradeoffs and an impossibility result for squared-path adaptation.

papers.title: Fast Rates in Stochastic Online Convex Optimization by Exploiting the Curvature of Feasible Sets
papers.tldr: Under stated stochastic conditions, curvature-adaptive algorithms exploit feasible-set geometry for logarithmic regret while retaining guarantees under adversarial or corrupted losses.

papers.title: From Linear to Linearizable Optimization: A Novel Framework with Applications to Stationary and Non-stationary DR-submodular Optimization
papers.tldr: A general conversion framework turns linear and quadratic optimization methods into algorithms for broader objectives and feedback settings.

papers.title: Fully Unconstrained Online Learning
papers.tldr: An online optimization technique adapts to unknown loss and comparator scales while matching optimal regret up to logarithmic factors in the stated sublinear regimes.

papers.title: Gradient-Variation Online Learning under Generalized Smoothness
papers.tldr: The paper extends gradient-variation online learning to generalized smoothness and adapts to convexity without prior curvature knowledge.

papers.title: Near-Optimal Dynamic Regret for Adversarial Linear Mixture MDPs
papers.tldr: A hybrid algorithm achieves near-optimal dynamic regret with unknown transitions and adversarial rewards without knowing the amount of non-stationarity beforehand.

papers.title: Online Composite Optimization Between Stochastic and Adversarial Environments
papers.tldr: Online composite optimization can match unregularized regret bounds while adapting to mixtures of stochastic noise and adversarial change.

papers.title: Online Convex Optimisation: The Optimal Switching Regret for all Segmentations Simultaneously
papers.tldr: The proposed online optimizer achieves asymptotically optimal switching regret for all segmentations simultaneously with logarithmic memory and per-step computation.

papers.title: Online Non-convex Learning in Dynamic Environments
papers.tldr: Restarted and dynamically combined FTPL learners provide regret guarantees for online non-convex learning in changing environments.

papers.title: Optimal Algorithms for Online Convex Optimization with Adversarial Constraints
papers.tldr: A first-order online policy simultaneously achieves square-root-scale regret and constraint violations, with logarithmic regret under strongly convex costs.

papers.title: Optimal Scalarizations for Sublinear Hypervolume Regret
papers.tldr: Randomly weighted nonlinear hypervolume scalarizations achieve an asymptotically optimal regret rate for exploring multiple objectives.

papers.title: Universal Online Convex Optimization with $1$ Projection per Round
papers.tldr: Universal online optimization algorithms achieve optimal regret across several convex function classes using only one domain projection per round.

papers.title: Constrained Online Convex Optimization with Polyak Feasibility Steps
papers.tldr: Polyak feasibility corrections enforce constraints at every round of online convex optimization while preserving square-root regret guarantees.

papers.title: Exploiting Curvature in Online Convex Optimization with Delayed Feedback
papers.tldr: New online optimization algorithms combine curvature-sensitive guarantees with total-delay bounds to handle delayed feedback more effectively.

papers.title: General framework for online-to-nonconvex conversion: Schedule-free SGD is also effective for nonconvex optimization
papers.tldr: A general online-to-nonconvex conversion framework establishes optimal iteration complexity for schedule-free SGD in nonsmooth, nonconvex optimization.

papers.title: High-Dimensional Prediction for Sequential Decision Making
papers.tldr: An efficient multidimensional forecasting algorithm supports conditional bias guarantees, downstream regret guarantees, and online multicalibration in adversarial settings.

papers.title: Non-stationary Online Learning for Curved Losses: Improved Dynamic Regret via Mixability
papers.tldr: Using mixability yields a dynamic-regret bound with linear dimensional dependence and a simpler analysis for curved online-learning losses.

papers.title: On the Dynamic Regret of Following the Regularized Leader: Optimism with History Pruning
papers.tldr: Optimistic cost handling and selective history pruning let FTRL recover dynamic regret guarantees by keeping its state aligned with its iterates.

papers.title: Online Learning with Unknown Constraints
papers.tldr: The paper develops a general method for learning under unknown safety constraints, with per-round high-probability safety and square-root regret for linear constraints.

papers.title: Revisiting Differentially Private Algorithms for Decentralized Online Learning
papers.tldr: A private decentralized learning algorithm nearly matches non-private regret bounds under a stated privacy-network condition, with a projection-free efficiency variant.

papers.title: Unconstrained Robust Online Convex Optimization
papers.tldr: These online algorithms provide explicit regret guarantees under arbitrarily arising gradient corruption, even when comparison points are unbounded.

papers.title: Wait-Less Offline Tuning and Re-solving for Online Decision Making
papers.tldr: Periodic linear-program solves combined with first-order updates improve the tradeoff between online decision quality and computational cost.

papers.title: An Ellipsoid Algorithm for Online Convex Optimization
papers.tldr: Dynamically updated ellipsoids enable projection-free online convex optimization with regret that depends only logarithmically on feasible-set asphericity.

papers.title: Beyond $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ Constraint Violation for Online Convex Optimization with Adversarial Constraints
papers.tldr: A tunable online optimization policy trades higher regret for smaller cumulative constraint violations, with efficient algorithms for expert and smooth settings.

papers.title: Comparator-Adaptive $\Phi$-Regret: Improved Bounds, Simpler Algorithms, and Applications to Games
papers.tldr: A prior over action transformations yields simpler algorithms with improved adaptive regret bounds and stronger equilibrium-convergence guarantees for a class of games.

papers.title: Contextual Online Pricing with (Biased) Offline Data
papers.tldr: The paper establishes optimal regret guarantees for contextual pricing with biased historical data and a robust method for unknown bias.

papers.title: Dynamic Regret Reduces to Kernelized Static Regret
papers.tldr: Viewing a changing benchmark as a fixed function converts dynamic regret into kernelized static regret and yields broader adaptive guarantees.

papers.title: Establishing Linear Surrogate Regret Bounds for Convex Smooth Losses via Convolutional Fenchel–Young Losses
papers.tldr: A convex-analysis construction yields smooth convex surrogates with linear regret transfer for arbitrary discrete target losses when paired with tailored prediction links.

papers.title: Fairness-Regularized Online Optimization with Switching Costs
papers.tldr: FairOBD balances operating, switching, and long-term fairness costs, with guarantees against a constrained offline benchmark and favorable resource-provisioning results.

papers.title: Finite Sample Analyses for Continuous-time Linear Systems: System Identification and Online Control
papers.tldr: The paper gives optimal finite-observation system identification up to constants and uses it to obtain square-root-time regret in controllable continuous-time linear systems.

papers.title: Gradient-Variation Online Adaptivity for Accelerated Optimization with Hölder Smoothness
papers.tldr: Adaptive online algorithms yield optimization methods that adjust to unknown Hölder smoothness, including conditional acceleration for strongly convex problems.

papers.title: High-Dimensional Calibration from Swap Regret
papers.tldr: A swap-regret method connects multidimensional forecast calibration to online optimization rates and establishes an unavoidable exponential dependence on inverse accuracy.

papers.title: Maximizing the Value of Predictions in Control: Accuracy Is Not Enough
papers.tldr: The paper measures predictions by their optimal control-cost benefit and shows why forecast accuracy alone can misrepresent that value.

papers.title: Minimax Adaptive Online Nonparametric Regression over Besov spaces
papers.tldr: An adaptive wavelet algorithm achieves minimax-optimal online regression guarantees and can exploit variations in local smoothness.

papers.title: $O(\sqrt{T})$ Static Regret and Instance Dependent Constraint Violation for Constrained Online Convex Optimization
papers.tldr: A geometry-aware online optimization algorithm preserves O(√T) regret while tightening constraint-violation bounds for favorable problem instances.

papers.title: On the necessity of adaptive regularisation: Optimal anytime online learning on $\boldsymbol{\ell_p}$-balls
papers.tldr: For separable FTRL regularizers on lp-balls with p greater than two, adaptation is necessary for optimal performance across dimensional regimes.

papers.title: Online Inverse Linear Optimization: Efficient Logarithmic-Regret Algorithm, Robustness to Suboptimality, and Lower Bound
papers.tldr: An online Newton method achieves logarithmic regret for inverse linear optimization without per-round complexity growing with the time horizon.

papers.title: Optimistic Online-to-Batch Conversions for Accelerated Convergence and Universality
papers.tldr: New optimistic online-to-batch conversions yield optimal acceleration and adaptation to unknown smoothness with one gradient query per iteration.

papers.title: Parameter-free Algorithms for the Stochastically Extended Adversarial Model
papers.tldr: The paper gives SEA online-optimization algorithms that adapt without knowing domain diameter or loss Lipschitz constants in advance.

papers.title: Simultaneous Swap Regret Minimization via KL-Calibration
papers.tldr: KL-Calibration links log-loss swap regret to broader calibration and simultaneous regret guarantees across classes of proper losses.

papers.title: Stochastic Regret Guarantees for Online Zeroth- and First-Order Bilevel Optimization
papers.tldr: A new search direction enables first- and zeroth-order online bilevel methods with sublinear stochastic regret without window smoothing.

papers.title: Stochastic Shortest Path with Sparse Adversarial Costs
papers.tldr: New regularizers exploit sparse costs optimally when transitions are known, while unknown transitions retain substantial state-action dependence.

papers.title: Transfer Faster, Price Smarter: Minimax Dynamic Pricing under Cross-Market Preference Shift
papers.tldr: CM-TDP transfers pricing information across markets with structured preference shifts and achieves minimax-optimal regret under the studied utility assumptions.

papers.title: Uniform Wrappers: Bridging Concave to Quadratizable Functions in Online Optimization
papers.tldr: Uniform wrappers transfer optimization algorithms and regret proofs to quadratizable settings, yielding improved guarantees for several feedback regimes.

papers.title: When Lower-Order Terms Dominate: Adaptive Expert Algorithms for Heavy-Tailed Losses
papers.tldr: New adaptive expert algorithms improve regret guarantees for heavy-tailed losses by removing a supposedly minor term that can dominate existing bounds.

papers.title: A Two-Layer Framework for Joint Online Configuration Selection and Admission Control
papers.tldr: A two-stage online algorithm coordinates configuration choices and request acceptance with a regret guarantee against a switching-aware benchmark.

papers.title: CLASP: Online learning algorithms for Convex Losses And Squared Penalties
papers.tldr: CLASP controls online loss and squared constraint violations, achieving logarithmic bounds for both under strong convexity.

papers.title: Decentralized Online Convex Optimization with Efficient Communication: Improved Algorithm and Lower Bounds
papers.tldr: A blocking, gossip, and error-compensation scheme improves regret guarantees for decentralized learning with compressed communication.

papers.title: Decision-Focused Learning via Tangent-Space Projection of Prediction Error
papers.tldr: PEAR uses a conditional geometric formula for regret gradients to train decision-focused predictors efficiently.

papers.title: Dynamic Regret via Discounted-to-Dynamic Reduction with Applications to Curved Losses and Adam Optimizer
papers.tldr: A modular discounted-to-dynamic reduction yields regret guarantees for online regression and convergence results for Adam variants.

papers.title: Finite and Corruption-Robust Regret Bounds in Online Inverse Linear Optimization under M-Convex Action Sets
papers.tldr: For M-convex action sets, the paper proves finite O(d log d) regret and extends it to unknown amounts of corrupted feedback.

papers.title: Logarithmic Switching Regret for Online Convex Optimization
papers.tldr: IRESET combines interval-based experts to obtain logarithmic switching-regret bounds for exponentially concave and strongly convex online objectives.

papers.title: Next-Token Prediction and Regret Minimization
papers.tldr: Next-token predictors can be made robust for online decisions with tiny distributional changes when context permits, but fixed windows can prevent this.

papers.title: Non-Stationary Online Structured Prediction with Surrogate Losses
papers.tldr: The paper bounds online prediction loss against a changing comparator, with tight dependence on its surrogate loss and amount of movement.

papers.title: Online Conformal Prediction via Universal Portfolio Algorithms
papers.tldr: UP-OCP uses universal portfolio algorithms and a regret-to-coverage theory to produce prediction intervals without learning-rate tuning.

papers.title: Optimal Anytime Algorithms for Online Convex Optimization with Adversarial Constraints
papers.tldr: A horizon-independent algorithm achieves square-root regret and nearly square-root cumulative constraint violation under adversarial convex costs and constraints.

papers.title: Parameter-free Dynamic Regret: Time-varying Movement Costs, Delayed Feedback, and Memory
papers.tldr: A new adaptive regret bound handles arbitrarily varying movement costs and yields guarantees for online learning with delays or changing memory.

papers.title: Upper-Linearizability of Online Non-Monotone DR-Submodular Maximization over Down-Closed Convex Sets
papers.tldr: A new upper-linearizability result reduces a class of online diminishing-returns problems to linear optimization and strengthens regret guarantees.
